title: Sony WH-1000XM6 Black (Grey Import) $466.99 Delivered @ TechintheBasket
body:
Deal: Sony WH-1000XM6 Black (Grey Import) $466.99 Delivered @ TechintheBasket

[Mikael] Good price. Paid $520 2 or so months back. Great sound and noice cancellation. Feels sturdy. The app bit flimsy especially on Android tablet
[Morien] OP, thanks for sharing, but unless we all have access to those vouchers, this isn't exactly an obtainable deal.
[Morien] When posted, the deal wasn’t for techinthebasket. It was specifically for price matching and then using vouchers on top.
[Binubenoy] You can price match nd still pay using the gift card which would only cost $452 for the $466 gift card
[Morien] What gift card? Is there another deal on?
[Binubenoy] I buy gift cards via Bupa Life rewards which has 3% discount on Good Guys gift cards. I use them often
[hollykryten] I don't think that TGG is going to be price matching a grey import from Hong Kong. Dead set giveaway their business address is located in Hong Kong so a foreign located business. It's not an Australian seller at all.
[Binubenoy] FYI I price matchED the TGG price with the Good Guys, i didnt buy from TGG
[hollykryten] Which is why if you value Australian manufacturer warranty you shouldn't buy this Hong Kong stock grey import with only foreign Hong Kong sellers warranty. The hinge could break and then you've got to resort to seller warranty from a Hong Kong seller. And if the seller packs up shop and disappears then you're left with nothing. Australian consumer law can't touch a foreign located business. So there you go.
[Binubenoy] Post was not about buying from them, it was about buying from local Australian stores using the price match policy
[hollykryten] JB won't (well knowingly) price match a grey import seller. This has to be an Australian authorised Sony reseller for them to price match. If any JB staff price match against TechintheBasket then they've made a mistake as they are a grey import seller (that's also not even located in Australia). So good luck with that.
"Exclusions apply for:
Grey or direct import products not sold through an authorised Australian reseller,"
https://www.jbhifi.com.au/pages/help-and-support/what-is-the…
Same no grey import products in the price match policy exists for TGG and Officeworks. No price matching a grey import.
[hollykryten] Their business address is in Hong Kong. Where the business is actually located. No Australian presence.
"ABOUT TechintheBasket
Business Address (Not Return Address):
SYM HONG KONG LIMITED
FLAT/RM 510 5/F Wayson Commercial Buildind 28 Connaught Road West Sheung Wan, Hong Kong"
So this isn't Australian stock nor is it being sold by an Australian business. This has nothing at all to do with Australia. This is dead set going to be a grey import stock that's being shipped from Hong Kong.
You aren't getting Australian warranty. You're only getting 12 months sellers warranty (from a business located in Hong Kong) and that mightn't be worth the paper that it's printed on.
"Standard Warranty
To provide customers with confidence and peace of mind when shopping on our website, TechintheBasket offers up to a 12-month standard warranty on its products (accessories not included)."
So that screams of "this is not stock from actual Australian distributed stock. Because if it was it would come with actual Australian manufacturer warranty, and not crappy seller warranty. That it's stock coming shipped from Hong Kong where the seller is located".
Web site looks like it was made by a 12 year old too.
So don't go trying to rely on Sony for warranty with this grey import from Hong Kong.
So this is actually a bad deal considering that you're getting a grey import from Hong Kong with no manufacturer warranty at all for those living in Australia. That you have to completely rely on the foreign seller for any seller warranty and the seller could just disappear at any time leaving you with no warranty at all.
[Binubenoy] Mate post want promoting to buy from
HongKong based site, i bought from Good Guys.
[hollykryten] Rookie mistake to think that just because the web site has a .com.au domain that it must be from an Australian business. It's actually a completely foreign business with an Australian domain to fool unsuspecting people into thinking Australian. Nothing to do with this business is Australian.
The Australian retailers aren't going to be knowingly price matching against a foreign located business. Sure some stupid retail staff members might make a mistake and let a price match accidentally slip through.
[Binubenoy] I did them over online and my friend bought did via store same day as well. So surely they do match up the price 🤷🏼
[hollykryten] Well staff at retailers like JB, TGG, Officeworks etc aren't supposed to price match a grey import seller as it's directly in violation of their own price match policy. That's all i'm saying.
[Evilgamer] I had them price match some Sony earbuds from this website yesterday https://mymobile.com.au/products/sony-wh-1000x-m6-wireless-n… its $489 but at least you will have a better chance being an Australian store
[hollykryten] I just did my quick research. It's an Australian business which deals in grey import stock and offers only sellers warranty to customers because it's not official Australian distribution stock so it comes with no Australian manufacturers warranty. But at least it's sold by an actual Australian business. You've still got to rely on only a sellers warranty and no Australian manufacturers warranty.
[Binubenoy] I did price match with my mobile website for $471 then i found the more cheaper price in the tech in the basket website and they price matched to $466.
[Evilgamer] Yeah you got lucky I tried price matching the wf-1000xm5 earbuds from techinthebasket.com for $245 but they wouldn’t do it so had to get them to price match mymobile.com for $301
[hollykryten] TechintheBasket is a direct ship from overseas grey import seller which is located in Hong Kong. That's why they knocked your price match back. Australian retailers won't price match a grey import product. For them to price match it needs to be a product from an authorised Australian reseller. And that isn't TechintheBasket.
[GeNTeCH] Still rocking the XM3's I picked up for $200 a few years back, yeah old school now I know.. not parting with them unless they die.
[ShiKu] I've got both the wh and wf xm3s and only just had to replace the battery in the wf. Otherwise they're both going strong, and I've had them since 2019
[Geek Girl] 25% of their Trustpilot reviews are one star.
[Binubenoy] Price match that price in Good Guys and Jbhifi. They do that
[hollykryten] Yes they do price match as long as it's from an Australian authorised reseller. TechintheBasket is not an Australian authrorised reseller for Sony. They are not even Australian to begin with. Located in Hong Kong with no presence in Australia nor are any of the products they sell located in Australia. I'd say they ship these Sony headphones either from Hong Kong or China.
Both TGG and JB have in their official price match policy an exclusion of not to price match a grey import product.
[Dumbfkncmtreplier] got white ones for $463 price matched tgg via chat, not sure whats wrong with the other commentors, nearly ATL thanks OP!
